subject: VERIFICATION: Session 94 deployment — 3 items not fully landed on Chromabook

content.summary: Independent verification of Session 94 fleet deployment. Budget fix, escalation clearance, and schema migration all confirmed working. Three items reported as deployed did not fully land on the Chromabook.
verified_working: escalation_present dropped to 0.0 across fleet (files cleared, signal no longer inflates activation)
Budget schema migrated — budget_spent/budget_cutoff/sleep_mode columns resolve on all 6 agents
Budget rows exist for psy-session + ops-session, budget_cutoff=0 (unlimited)
Gc selective attention layer operational — events handled without spurious spawning
All 6 meshd instances online and stable (0 failed deliberations)

not_landed.evidence: SSH check: `ls ~/platform/scripts/deliberate.sh ~/projects/psychology/platform/shared/scripts/deliberate.sh` → 'not found'. `which claude` on Chromabook → 'not found'. Observatory fires at activation=0.700 but meshd cannot spawn — no claude binary in PATH and no deliberate.sh wrapper to resolve it.
not_landed.impact: All 4 Chromabook agents cannot deliberate. Observatory has 82 unprocessed messages (grew from 15 during session) and cannot drain its backlog.
not_landed.fix: Copy deliberate.sh to Chromabook (e.g., ~/platform/scripts/deliberate.sh), ensure executable, restart meshd instances with SPAWN_COMMAND=~/platform/scripts/deliberate.sh. Or: install claude CLI on Chromabook so bare `claude` resolves.

not_landed.evidence: sqlite3 query on all 4 Chromabook state.db files: COUNT(*)=0. The table exists (bootstrap confirmed) but no agent has deliberated since deployment, so no GWT broadcasts have fired and no activations recorded.
not_landed.impact: Expected — not a deployment failure. Data will accumulate once deliberations resume. Noting for completeness.
not_landed.fix: None needed — will self-resolve once deliberations fire.

not_landed.evidence: `strings meshd | grep oscillator-shadow` → found. Binary still writes oscillator-shadow.jsonl (23KB, actively growing at 10:02). The activation-trace.jsonl file (3221 lines) stopped updating at 09:10 when old meshd process died.
not_landed.impact: Cosmetic — gray-box writes to old filename. Functional impact: none (data still records). Fix requires Go build with private repo auth.
not_landed.fix: Rebuild meshd binary on gray-box: `cd ~/Projects/meshd && go build -o meshd ./cmd/meshd/`. Requires GOPRIVATE=github.com/safety-quotient-lab/* and git SSH auth for private module deps.

remaining_structural.peer_heartbeat_stale: 0.500 across all 6 agents. meshd replaced autonomous-sync.sh but never absorbed heartbeat.py emission. Adds permanent +0.05 activation inflation (weight 0.10 × 0.5). Recommend meshd Go goroutine for periodic heartbeat file writes.

epistemic_flags: Observatory 82 unprocessed count may include addressed copies (to-*) alongside genuine inbound — the 15→82 growth occurred during ops' fleet restart, possibly from re-indexing
